title: The Hematic Order
subtitle: Blood is not a curse
text: The Harbingers of the Hematic Order do not view blood magic as dark or taboo. To them it is a sacred inheritance — the most profound material in existence, the carrier of life, of memory, of identity. They are shunned by common folk not because they have done wrong, but because they are different in a way that unsettles people who have never felt their own blood speak. They are a found family built around something most of the world is afraid to look at.
